title: Shipping Documentation Executive ( Export & Import Iron and steel)
description:
**Role Summary**

The Shipping Documentation Executive will handle all export documentation and coordination for metal shipments, ensuring compliance with customs, banking, and export requirements. The role demands strong attention to detail, accuracy in documentation, and effective coordination with logistics partners and internal teams.

**KRA: Task / Activities**

* Prepare and verify all pre-shipment and post-shipment export documents such as Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, and other required documents.
* Ensure documents comply with buyer requirements and export procedures.
* Coordinate with shipping lines and freight forwarders for booking and dispatch.
* Handle submission of required export documents to banks for payment realization.
* Liaise with internal teams such as Sales, Accounts, and Production for shipment scheduling and readiness.
* Maintain accurate documentation records and ensure compliance with DGFT and customs norms.
* Track shipments and update clients and management on dispatch status.
* Handle amendments and discrepancies in export documentation when required.

**KPI: Performance Metrics**

* Accuracy and completeness of export documentation.
* Timely submission of required export and bank documents.
* Smooth coordination with shipping and logistics partners.
* Compliance with export regulations and timelines.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of export documentation procedures.
* Experience working with shipping lines and freight forwarders.
* Familiarity with INCOTERMS, DGFT, and customs procedures.
* Good command over MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

**Preferred skills**

* Experience in the metal export/trading or manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in EDI filing and export documentation portals.
* Knowledge of banking documentation related to export transactions.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

title: Technical Writer - Docs-as-Code & AI-Assisted Documentation
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a skilled Technical Writer to create clear, accurate, and user-focused  
documentation for enterprise integration services and business-critical platforms.  
The ideal candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Implementation  
Teams, Customer Support, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to transform complex  
technical concepts into easy-to-understand documentation that enables successful

This role requires hands-on experience with Docs-as-Code methodologies, Markdown,  
Git workflows, AI-assisted content creation, and enterprise software documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Documentation Development**

troubleshooting documentation.  

* Develop user guides, FAQs, quick-reference materials, release notes, support

procedures, and escalation guides.

Docs-as-Code & Content Management

updates.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Define ownership, review schedules, and approval workflows.
* Monitor documentation analytics, support tickets, and feedback trends.
* Continuously improve content usability, accuracy, and discoverability.

title: Data Labeling Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** Data Labeling Specialist (In\-Office Contract)  
**Company:** Arijentek  
**Location:** Pollachi, India (On\-site)  
**Salary:** ₹2,40,000 to ₹4,80,000 per year (2\.4 LPA to 4\.8 LPA)  
**Job Type:** Contract  
**Working Hours:** Flexible schedule, maximum 50 hours per week

**About Us**

At Arijentek, we're not just labeling data, we're helping improve the technology people use every day. Our work creates the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

**What You'll Do**

Evaluate outputs from AI models, text, images, video, and documents against detailed criteria. Assess quality, spot errors and inconsistencies, and write clear, well\-reasoned justifications for your judgments. Every evaluation you complete helps these systems perform better in the real world.

**Who We're Looking For**

People who write clearly, think critically, and can back up a judgment call with a clear explanation. This role suits people who've done work built around precise written evaluation, UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial or research work, or writing technical specs and requirements.

* Strong readers and writers with sound judgment
* Comfortable evaluating creative or technical work against a set of criteria
* Takes quality seriously and catches what others miss
* Can follow detailed written guidelines independently
* Able to commute to and work from our Pollachi office

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, completed or in progress
* Excellent written English: clear, precise, well\-organized
* Strong attention to detail
* At least 1 year of experience in a role built around evaluating or reviewing work against a standard (e.g., UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial, research, QA, or technical writing). Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Technical Requirements**

* Proficient in using desktop or laptop computers running Windows 10 (or later) or macOS. *(Note: All necessary hardware and high\-speed internet will be provided at your dedicated workstation in our office).*

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** 2\.4 LPA to 4\.8 LPA, based on experience and performance.
* **On\-Site Flexibility:** Work from our Pollachi office while setting a flexible schedule that works for you, up to a maximum cap of 40 hours per week.
* **Support \& Growth:** Clear guidelines, comprehensive training, and ongoing performance feedback from our on\-site team.
* **Career Advancement:** Some of our most reliable, high\-performing contributors have grown into roles where they guide and support others, with compensation that reflects the added responsibility. These opportunities depend on performance and how the work is evolving, and we're glad to support people who are a strong fit.
* **Impact:** Join a mission\-driven team focused on accuracy and quality, helping build the data foundation behind better technology.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹480,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Evaluating data requires intense focus over long periods. What specific techniques do you use to maintain your attention to detail and avoid "auto\-piloting" during long annotation sessions?
* Imagine an AI is asked: "What is the capital of Australia?"

The AI responds: "The capital of Australia is Sydney, which is famous for its Opera House and beautiful harbor."

Please review this AI output. Is it accurate? Write a 2\-3 sentence evaluation explaining your judgment, exactly as you would write it for our engineering team.

* Describe a time when you had to review or evaluate work against a set of guidelines, but the guidelines didn't clearly cover the specific issue you found. How did you handle the edge case?
* Are you currently located in, or willing to commute daily to, our office in Pollachi?
* This is an in\-office contract role (up to 50 hours per week). Are you comfortable working on\-site under these conditions?

Work Location: In person
